landing.title: Your visuals and videos, on brand.
landing.subtitle: Say what you want to announce. iVision reads your website, picks up your colours and fonts, and creates the visual or the motion-design video. Show a model video: it reproduces its animations with your texts and images.
landing.account: With your IDEM account and IDEM credits: nothing else to set up.

demo.label: Sample conversation with iVision
demo.user: A video for our year-end sale, 30% off everything
demo.ask: Do you have a model video to reproduce? I’ll reuse its animations and rhythm, with your brand.
demo.done: Your video is ready: the model’s four shots, with your texts, photos and colours.

site.title: Your website becomes your brand book
site.text: Paste your website link: iVision reads its colours, fonts, logo and tone, then offers three palettes and three typography pairings. You choose, it remembers.

model.title: Show a model, it reproduces it
model.text: A video or poster you like? Add it: iVision reuses its cuts, motion and layout — with your texts, your images, your music.

edit.title: Edit live
edit.text: Click a text: the video jumps to the moment it shows, and changes as you type. Replace a photo in one click.

modes.title: Visuals and videos — each its own studio
modes.text: No mixing: one conversation makes visuals, another makes videos. Each keeps its settings and history.

image.title: Visuals
image.text: Posters, posts, stories, banners: laid out precisely and checked before delivery.

video.title: Motion-design videos
video.text: From 6 to 60 seconds, story, square, portrait or landscape, with royalty-free music and sound effects.

credits.title: Same account, same credits
credits.text: iVision uses your IDEM account: same credits, same prices as your dashboard. Import an IDEM project’s brand book in one click.

landing.footer: Create and launch a profitable business

creativity.label: Creativity
creativity.hint: The higher the level, the more the AI decides (and the higher the price).
